summary.es: Cómo obtener la nueva mascota musical Gustjumper en WoW: Forever...

contentHtml:
In World of Warcraft: Forever, players can acquire several new pets, including the Musical Gustjumper.

Musical Gustjumper
Item Level 1
Use: Teaches you how to summon this companion.

Right Click to summon and dismiss your musical froggy friend.
Sell Price: 1


Forever Zones Overview - New & Updated Zones

How to Acquire the Musical Gustjumper Pet

You can acquire the Musical Gustjumper pet on Zephras Isle at /way 51.5 72.3. This is easy even for a level one, and depending on luck with patrolling enemies, you might not actually enter combat at all. Just follow the road south from Thendal Village, and eventually you'll cut across a short field to get to the waterfalls - just don't overshoot and run too far down the path below them.


Tip: Click map to zoom
Zephras Isle



Once you arrive there, you'll find a group of Musical Gustjumper on a rock at the top of the waterfall. You'll want to jump on the log to reach them easily. Target a frog and use the /sing emote; it will sing back, the group will disappear, and a clickable frog will spawn nearby on the log with you. Click the frog to acquire the Musical Gustjumper pet.

contentHtml:
In World of Warcraft: Forever, players can discover two new pets in two of the game's most prominent cities: Stormwind City and Undercity.

Forever Zones Overview - New & Updated Zones

Baby Crocolisk in Stormwind

In Stormwind, Alliance players learned that defeating Sewer Beast, which patrols the Stormwind Canals, drops a Baby Crocolisk pet. In the beta, the Sewer Beast is an elite mob at level 50, but massive raid groups have defeated it.

Baby Crocolisk
Item Level 50
Binds when picked up
Use: Teaches you how to summon this companion.

Right Click to summon and dismiss your baby crocolisk.
Sell Price: 5


Excitable Slime in Undercity

Another new pet players can acquire in Undercity (without needing a raid group) is the Excitable Slime, but it takes a bit more effort than defeating the Sewer Beast - at least in terms of figuring out what to do.

  1. Purchase a Nutritious Slime Sludge from Boyle in Undercity at around /way 56.2 64.6.
  2. Jump into the canal and locate an Excitable Slime patrolling.
  3. Spam the /dance emote at the Excitable Slime until it emotes back at you.
  4. This will take several tries, so keep spamming it.
  5. Eventually, after enough /dance spams, the Excitable Slime will offer you the quest WRIGGLE..
  6. To complete this quest, you'll need to trade the Excitable Slime a Nutritious Slime Sludge.
  7. After doing so, you'll receive an Excitable Slime of your own.




The best part is, emoting /dance at the companion pet will make your little slime dance again, letting you wriggle wherever you are!

Blizzard
View Original
September 29, 2026

Dungeons and Raids
  • The Venomous Abyss
    • Ula’tek
      • Fixed an issue with Ula’tek’s Mother’s Wrath where it can be cast at a target that isn’t the current target if a non-target has higher threat but hasn’t passed the threat threshold to force a target change.
Events
  • Brewfest
    • Items that drop from Coren Direbrew should now have the required level set to the player who receives the item. They could still trade it but players at lower levels will have to reach the required level to equip it.

contentHtml:
Blizzard has posted Patch 12.1.5 PTR development notes for today which includes bug fixes and class changes!
Blizzard
View Original
Here are this week’s additions to the 12.1.5 PTR:

CLASSES

  • EVOKER
    • Augmentation
      • Chronowarden
        • Temporality duration is now increased by Mastery: Timewalker.
        • Temporal Burst duration is now increased by Mastery: Timewalker.
      • Scalecommander
        • Melt Armor damage increased by 100%.
    • Preservation
      • Consume Flame no longer double dips from healing increases on the target.
      • Chronowarden
        • Fixed an issue where extending Fire Breath with Double-time could cause Life-Giver’s Flame to stop healing.
        • Fixed an issue where Afterimage was causing Deep Breath to sometimes cast Living Flame on the Evoker.
  • HUNTER
    • Marksmanship
      • Fixed an issue where Explosive Shot would automatically select and fire at a nearby target if pressed without a target currently selected.
      • Dark Ranger
        • Fixed an issue where Umbral Reach was not generating Trick Shots when Bleak Powder hit exactly 2 targets.
    • Survival
      • Fixed an issue where Strike as One bonus damage from Raptor Swipe (Rank 3) did not properly work while Aspect of the Eagle was active.
      • Fixed an issue where Raptor Swipe had a longer range than intended while Aspect of the Eagle was active.
  • MAGE
    • Frost
      • Fixed an issue where a Splitting Ice Frostbolt had a smaller search radius for its second target than other spells.
      • Fixed an issue with Shatter where if two Ice Lances were in the air at the same time, with the first benefitting from Fingers of Frost and the second not, neither would benefit from Fingers of Frost. This could also occur with Thermal Void, which is also fixed.
      • Fixed an issue with Crystalline Refraction where interrupting Ray of Frost by casting Ray of Frost could cause it to not generate Fingers of Frost.
  • MONK
    • Fixed an issue where Transcendence: Transfer could be used while silenced if talented into Transcendence: Linked Spirits.
  • ROGUE
    • Assassination
      • Mutilate has an updated weapon trail.
      • Crimson Tempest animation has been updated and now has a weapon trail.
    • Subtlety
      • Shadow Blades has an updated cast visual and weapon visual.
  • SHAMAN
    • Enhancement
      • Fixed an issue where Static Accumulation could cause Maelstrom Weapon stacks to stop automatically generating if activated during certain points of Ascendance or Doom Winds being active.
    • Restoration
      • Extending Riptide through Swelling Tides now causes Riptide’s timer to extend rather than reset.
      • Fixed an issue where Nature’s Swiftness and Ancestral Swiftness did not properly make Healing Rain instant cast.
  • WARRIOR
    • Protection
      • Colossus
        • Developers’ notes: Colossus is intended to reflect a Warrior’s innate prowess and skill, and this represents itself for Protection by being more efficient with Rage. We feel that Colossus will benefit from having more efficient access to Revenge and Execute for a more unique rotation and better threat management tools. Note: These changes were active in last week’s PTR build.
        • Practiced Strikes now has an additional effect – Execute and Revenge rage cost reduced by 10.

PLAYER VERSUS PLAYER

  • EVOKER
    • Preservation
      • Merithra’s Blessing is now considered an Arcane spell, and can be cast when locked out of Nature.

USER INTERFACE AND ACCESSIBILITY

  • Preview settings on the Trading Post UI, such as “Combat Animation”, will now remember the player’s choice when swapping between items.

contentHtml:
Blizzard has announced that weekly Bonus Rolls will unlock next week, with more power coming soon in the following weeks.

Bonus Loot Rolls & Ascendant Venomstones


With Patch 12.1.5 launching on October 13th, Blizzard has revealed the schedule for more of the player power systems coming in the next few weeks:
  • October 6th - Weekly Bonus Rolls unlocks
  • October 13th - New Patch
  • October 20th - Ascendant Venomstones unlocks & Crest Cap removed
Blizzard
View Original

Mid-Season Refresh: Unlock New Power


During realm maintenance the week of 7 October , Orin Straylight will begin to offer one additional Nebulous Voidcore a week to bonus roll for additional loot.

Prepare to unlock these additional Nebulous Voidcores before Midnight’s 12.1.5 content update goes live. First, accept the "In the Catalyst's Shadow" quest from Decimus in Voidstorm, then travel to Silvermoon City and pick up the “Prismatic Potential” quest from Orin Straylight. To get an early start on the Nebulous Voidcore quest chain, we encourage Azeroth’s brave champions to complete both quests before weekly maintenance during the week of October 6.

Once “Prismatic Potential” is turned in, Orin can begin his research, and a progress timer will appear above his head. After completing his research during the week of October 6, he will offer the quest "Umbral Blessings of the Catalyst". Completing this quest will unlock the ability to trade in gold, Voidlight Marl, or Veteran Mistcrests to Orin for one additional Nebulous Voidcore a week.

During realm maintenance the week of October 13, Orin will offer the quest, "Ancient Depths, Ancient Venom". Once this quest is complete, Orin will begin his next research of Ascendant Venomstones. Orin will complete his research during realm maintenance the week of October 20 and offer players "Ascending with Venomstones", letting players take their power to new heights. Completing this quest will empower defenders of the realm to acquire Ascendant Venomstones, which drop from every Heroic or Mythic raid boss, Mythic+ Keystone dungeons at +10 and above, Tier 11 Bountiful Delves, and Nightmare Prey Hunt Champion gear chests.

After collecting 10 Ascendant Venomstones, use them near the Catalyst in Silvermoon City to raise the item level of a fully upgraded Season 2 Hero, Myth, or maximum-quality Tidal Crafted weapon, trinket, or necklace.

Along with Ascendant Venomstones, the week of 20 October, the crest cap will be lifted.
